Notes: First mention of a Jewish community in Narodichi
Pogroms by various bands: 15 murdered and 13 wounded; organized Jewish community
Occupied 22 Aug 1941; killings by local police: up to 600 killed 28-29 Aug 1941 and remaining 370 on 16 Nov 1941 at Jewish cemetery (murder counts not population)
About 100 Jews remained/returned after the war (approximate)
About 30-40 Jews lived there at time of Chernobyl disaster; most were relocated (range, no single count)
